Operations.Name: NvmetNamespaceCreate
Operations.Description:
Create a NVMe target namespace in a subsystem (`subsys`).

This will expose the namespace to any hosts permitted to access the subsystem.

Arguments.Name: nvmet_namespace_create
Arguments.Description: NVMe-oF namespace configuration data for creation.

Arguments.Name: id
Arguments.Description: ID of the NVMe-oF namespace to delete.

Operations.Name: NvmetNamespaceGetInstance
Operations.Description:
Returns instance matching `id`. If `id` is not found, Validation error is raised.

Please see `query` method documentation for `options`.

Fields.Name: DeviceNguid
Fields.Description: Namespace Globally Unique Identifier for the namespace.

Fields.Name: DevicePath
Fields.Description:
Path to the device or file being used to implement the namespace.

When `device_type` is:

* "ZVOL": `device_path` is e.g. "zvol/poolname/zvolname"
* "FILE": `device_path` is e.g. "/mnt/poolmnt/path/to/file". The file will be created if necessary.

Fields.Name: DeviceType
Fields.Description: Type of device (or file) used to implement the namespace.

Fields.Name: DeviceUuid
Fields.Description: Unique device identifier for the namespace.

Fields.Name: Enabled
Fields.Description:
If `enabled` is `False` then the namespace will not be accessible.

Some namespace configuration changes are blocked when that namespace is enabled.

Fields.Name: Filesize
Fields.Description: When `device_type` is "FILE" then this will be the size of the file in bytes.

Fields.Name: Id
Fields.Description: Unique identifier for the NVMe-oF namespace.

Fields.Name: Locked
Fields.Description:
Reflect the locked state of the namespace.

The underlying `device_path` could be an encrypted ZVOL, or a file on an encrypted dataset. In either case     `locked` will be `True` if the underlying entity is locked.

Fields.Name: Nsid
Fields.Description:
Namespace ID (NSID).

Each namespace within a subsystem has an associated NSID, unique within that subsystem.

If not supplied during `namespace` creation then the next available NSID will be used.

Fields.Name: Subsys
Fields.Description: NVMe-oF subsystem that contains this namespace.
